== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Wall Of Fire (Japanese)|Wall Of Fire]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944014/Cy6xvghLf0aS1nAUC28JCA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099885.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>f61d684a850356e2aa668ef0f181c73b0936f3cf0afc5d41b6a5d7e0506e32cb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
